routes.name: Right of Abode
routes.summary: Right to enter, live and work in Ghana indefinitely without a residence permit. Apply by letter to the Minister for the Interior with supporting documents.

other: Former Ghanaians who lost citizenship, or people of African descent living in the diaspora.
Include an application letter to the Minister of the Interior plus supporting documents.

routes.processing: Decision expected within six months after the Immigration Service sends its due diligence report.

routes.name: Naturalization as a Ghanaian Citizen
routes.summary: Citizenship for long-term residents. You need 12 months in Ghana right before applying, plus 5 years total in the 7 years before that, and you must speak an indigenous Ghanaian language.

eligibility.language: Speak and understand an indigenous Ghanaian language
other: Valid residence permit on the application date.
Sponsor Form 14 and a letter to the Minister of the Interior.

citizenship.note: Ghana allows dual citizenship. See the dual citizenship record.

routes.processing: About six months after the Ministry gets your complete forms.
